title: Stay on an almost untouched island among wild horses
description: Spend two or three nights in a historic Carnegie mansion reached by private ferry. Explore ancient moss-draped oaks, island landscapes and freely roaming horses with naturalists.
teaser: Spend two or three nights in a historic Carnegie mansion reached by private ferry.
goodToKnow: The earlier research listed a premium nightly rate that included meals, ferry and guided outings, plus a January 18 to 22, 2027 photo trip. Confirm current prices and availability; roads can be bumpy and the inn has stairs.
whyItMightDelightYou: Spend two or three nights in a historic Carnegie mansion reached by private ferry.
